revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: Too abstract. 'Universities and corporations face regulatory barriers' is generic and fails the 'So What?' test for Sony specifically.

revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: The connection to SGE's mission is asserted but not demonstrated. 'Research findings will inform curriculum design' is vague.

Updated action title to reference 'case studies for SGE's AI ethics curriculum' and 'Isozu-san's 2040 vision.'

revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: Missing the founder's personal story. The slide is organizational credentials without human authenticity.
revisions_applied_detail.revision_applied: Added the founder's journey narrative: 'Our founder built ZK Tokyo after recognizing that Japan's best researchers were isolated—like the engineer in Toyama who spent 5 years building an EVM compiler alone.' Updated speaker notes with full founder story including breaking out to the outside world and founding Nyx Foundation.

revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: Discrepancy: Source material says '20+ vulnerabilities,' but slide says '17 vulnerabilities in Fusaka audit.'
revisions_applied_detail.revision_applied: Clarified with precision: Added text below main fact stating '17 vulnerabilities in the Fusaka audit alone, with 20+ total across our security research portfolio.' Updated speaker notes to include both figures with context.

revisions_applied_detail.original_issue: The risk mitigation framing is defensive ('This is NOT connected to public crypto'). It reads like we're apologizing for blockchain.

revisions_applied_detail.revision_applied: Humanized the ask: Changed main text to 'Give us four weeks of your time. In return, we will show you whether this is worth pursuing together.' Uses statement layout for emotional impact while keeping practical details in smaller text.
